{{Top|leg}}
The '''Chume'da''' was the title given to the heir of the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]]; title holders included [[Kalen (Hapan)|Kalen]], [[Isolder]], and [[Allana Djo Solo]].
